learnings.title: GitHub changelog feed: Issue statuses and repository boards are in public preview
learnings.claim: GitHub changelog feed fetched 2026-11-24 lists as newest item: "Issue statuses and repository boards are in public preview" (Mon, 23 Nov 2026 20:37:11 +0000). Not independently verified.
learnings.decision: REVIEW_ONLY: The system plan should monitor the public preview of issue statuses and repository boards for future workflow evaluation while taking no immediate operational action.
learnings.next_measurement: Reviewer opens the item link and confirms relevance before promotion.
